gloss: deep-fried skewered meat, seafood, or vegetables

definitions.explanation: Bite-sized pieces of meat, seafood, or vegetables skewered on sticks, coated in batter and breadcrumbs, and deep-fried. A specialty of Osaka's Shinsekai district.

examples.japanese: {串|くし}カツ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べよう→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{串|くし}カツ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二度漬|にどづ}け⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧だ。
examples.english: In Osaka, double-dipping is forbidden with kushikatsu.

examples.japanese: {新世界|しんせかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{串|くし}カツ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{色|いろ}んな→色んな：02992_ironna⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{串|くし}→串：19339_kushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
examples.english: At a kushikatsu restaurant in Shinsekai, I ordered various kinds of skewers.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
A signature dish of ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧, especially the {新世界|しんせかい} district. The famous rule {二度漬|にどづ}け⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (no double-dipping) means you must not dip a skewer into the communal sauce more than once — use a cabbage leaf to scoop extra sauce instead.
